title: STORY COLLECTION: TO BE CONTINUED OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: TO BE CONTINUED OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Library Cards, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: To Be Continued event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Library Cards by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Library. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.

Test Collection - Traceless Walker for Adnachiel, Information Fragments, Module Data Blocks, Data Supplement Instruments, Data Supplement Sticks, Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Recruitment Permits, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Special Operation. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Special Operation.
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Rewinding Breeze will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.
